sette_e_mezzo_combination_classic: — 7.5 points with more than two cards.
sette_e_mezzo_combination_doppio7: — 2 sevens (this card combination is worth 7.5 points).
sette_e_mezzo_combination_mano: — a poker combination of the player's first two cards and the dealer's first card
sette_e_mezzo_combination_mano_1: Straight – all possible combinations: 234, 345, 456, 567, JQK, QKA
sette_e_mezzo_combination_mano_2: Flush – all three cards of the same suit
sette_e_mezzo_combination_mano_3: Three Of A Kind – all three cards of the same rank (example: 333, JJJ)
sette_e_mezzo_combination_mano_5: Royal Flush – QKA of the same suit
sette_e_mezzo_combination_partita: — when the first cards of the player and the dealer are the same (by rank)
sette_e_mezzo_combination_partita_1: Pair 1 to 6 (example: both the player and the dealer get an A as their first card or both the player and the dealer get a 6 as their first card)
sette_e_mezzo_combination_partita_2: Pair of picture cards (example: both the player and the dealer get a J as their first card; A is not a picture)
sette_e_mezzo_combination_partita_3: Pair of 7s (both the player and the dealer get a 7 as their first card)
sette_e_mezzo_combination_reale: — 7.5 points with two cards, one of which is a seven and the other is any face card (K, Q, J).
sette_e_mezzo_combination_realissimo: — 7.5 points with two cards, one of which is the king of diamonds.
sette_e_mezzo_combination_royal: — 7.5 points with two cards, one of which is a king of spades (example: king of spades + seven, king of spades + jack).
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_1: The game uses a 40-card deck with four suits.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_10: As per the order above, the cards have the following values: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_2: At the start of the game, the player and the dealer are dealt one card each.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_3: Then the player draws cards until they decide to stop or they go bust (over 7.5 points).
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_4: If the player draws the Royal Sette e Mezzo combination, the player wins (the dealer does not draw cards).
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_5: When the player stops, the dealer starts drawing cards. The dealer must keep drawing cards if they have less than 5 points or if the player has 7.5 points. The dealer must also take a second card if the first one is the king of spades. The dealer stops if they go bust. The dealer also stops if they have 5 or more points and the player has less than 7.5 points.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_6: The side that goes bust loses.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_7: If both sides have the same number of points, the game ends in a tie, apart from situations where Royal Sette e Mezzo is drawn (this is the strongest hand in the game and it leads to a win even if the points are equal) or the score is 5-5 (the dealer wins). In all other cases the side that has the most points wins.
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_8: The king of spades takes on the value of the most beneficial card (e.g. the king of spades plus an ace equals 7 points, the king of spades plus an ace and a jack equals 7.5 points).
sette_e_mezzo_new_rule_9: Ranking in the 40-card deck: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, J, Q, K, A.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_1: The game uses a 40-card deck with four suits.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_10: As per the order above, the cards have the following values: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_2: At the start of the game, the cards are dealt one at a time, face-up to the player and face-down to the dealer. The player then needs to make a decision: to draw another card or to stay. The dealer draws after the player.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_3: The player needs to score more points than the dealer, without exceeding 7.5 points.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_4: If the player and the dealer both score the same number of points and the player does not have a winning card combination (see card combinations), the dealer wins.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_5: If both the player and the dealer score 7.5 points each, the winner is whoever has the highest-value combination.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_6: If the player scores 8 or more points with any number of cards, the player goes bust and loses.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_7: If the dealer goes bust and the player does not, the player wins.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_8: The King of diamonds takes on the value of the most beneficial card for your current hand.
sette_e_mezzo_rule_9: Ranking in the 40-card deck: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, J, Q, K, A.
